q: In a circular motion, the object just moves in a _____.
e: Circular motion means the object travels on a circular path. A straight line or a parabola is a different path, so those options are wrong.

q: In rotational motion, the object rotates about an _____.
e: In rotational motion, the object rotates about an axis. Rotational motion means a body spins about an axis. plane or point is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: A rigid body is a body that does not _____ or change shape.
e: A rigid body is a body that does not deform or change shape. A rigid body keeps a fixed shape, so it does not deform. move or rotate is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: In a rigid body, the distance between any two particles within the body remains _____.
e: In a rigid body, the distance between any two particles within the body remains constant. A rigid body keeps a fixed shape, so the distance between any two of its particles stays constant. variable or zero is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: If a rigid body is in rotational motion, all the particles constituting it undergo _____ motion about a common axis.
e: If a rigid body is in rotational motion, all the particles constituting it undergo circular motion about a common axis. Each particle of a rotor travels on a circular path about the axis. linear or random is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: When an object rotates and its angular velocity changes at a constant rate, the motion is called the rotational motion under constant angular _____.
e: When an object rotates and its angular velocity changes at a constant rate, the motion is called the rotational motion under constant angular acceleration. Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity, written a or α. velocity or displacement is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The initial angular speed is the magnitude of angular velocity of the object at $t=$ _____.
e: The initial angular speed is the magnitude of angular velocity of the object at t= 0. Angular velocity ω tells how fast the rotation angle is changing. 1 or ∞ is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The equations for constant angular acceleration in rotational motion are _____ to equations for constant acceleration in linear motion.
e: The equations for constant angular acceleration in rotational motion are analogous to equations for constant acceleration in linear motion. Angular acceleration α is the rate of change of angular velocity ω. opposite or unrelated is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Average angular speed is expressed as $\omega = \frac{\omega + \omega_0}{_____}$.
e: Average angular speed is expressed as ω = (ω + ω₀)/(2). t or θ is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The rotation of earth about its own axis creates the cycle of _____.
e: The rotation of earth about its own axis creates the cycle of day and night. seasons or tides is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: If its angular velocity changes at a constant rate, then we can say that the angular acceleration is _____.
e: If its angular velocity changes at a constant rate, then we can say that the angular acceleration is constant. Angular acceleration α is the rate of change of angular velocity ω. zero or varying is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: In Grade 11, the angular displacement, angular velocity and angular acceleration of an object in _____ motion have been learnt.
e: In Grade 11, the angular displacement, angular velocity and angular acceleration of an object in circular motion have been learnt. Each particle of a rotor travels on a circular path about the axis. rotational or linear is a different idea, so those options are wrong.
